buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address RR Hill Bimdila West Kameng Arunachal Pradesh PIN-790001 . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque.

d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 5. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 6. Inspection Testing of Sample: The testing of advance sample and bulk sample during PDI will be carried at the designated AHSP labs.When testing facilities are not available, the facilities of Govt labs/NABL/Accredited labs will be utilized. The testing charges outside the designated AHSP labs to be borne by seller's. 7. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 10. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 11. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR PROCUREMENT OF LAPTOPS THROUGH GeM 1. Scope of Supply The bidder shall supply laptops strictly conforming to the technical specifications, quantity and other requirements specified in the GeM Bid/BOQ. 2. OEM & Product Compliance (a) The offered product shall be from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an

authorised channel partner/reseller of the OEM. (b) The bidder shall submit valid OEM Authorisation Certificate wherever applicable. (c) The offered model shall be a current production model and shall not be declared End-of- Life (EOL) or End-of-Sale (EOS) by the OEM at the time of supply. (d) The supplied laptops shall be brand new, unused and free from any manufacturing defect. 3. Technical Specifications (a) The laptop shall conform to all specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid. (b) Any deviation from the stipulated technical specifications shall be clearly brought out by the bidder. Silent deviation shall not be accepted. (c) The configuration supplied shall not be inferior to the configuration offered at the time of bidding. 4. Country of Origin The bidder shall clearly indicate the Country of Origin of the offered product. The bidder shall comply with all applicable Government of India provisions relating to procurement from entities/countries requiring restrictions or prior approval. 5. Make & Model The bidder shall mention the exact Make, Model Number and Part Number of the offered laptop in the bid. Supply of an alternative model without prior written approval of the Competent Authority shall not be permitted. 6. Warranty (a) Minimum warranty shall be as specified in the GeM Bid/BOQ. (b) Warranty shall be comprehensive and applicable from the date of successful installation/acceptance or delivery, as specified in the contract. (c) Warranty services shall be provided through the OEM/authorised service network. (d) The bidder/OEM shall attend warranty complaints within the stipulated response time. 7. Installation & Demonstration Where applicable, the bidder shall provide installation, configuration and demonstration of the supplied laptops at the consignee's location without any additional cost. 8. Delivery (a) Delivery shall be made at the consignee location specified in the GeM Contract. (b) The supplier shall ensure proper packing and transportation to prevent damage during transit. (c) All transportation, loading, unloading and delivery charges shall be borne by the supplier unless otherwise specified in the GeM Contract. 9. Inspection & Acceptance (a) The supplied laptops shall be subject to inspection by the consignee/authorised representative. (b) The laptops shall be checked for make, model, serial number, configuration, accessories, physical condition and functionality. (c) Any item found defective, damaged or not conforming to the specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost. 10. Serial Number & Asset Details The supplier shall provide a list containing: • Make & Model • Serial Number • Product/Part Number • OEM Warranty Details • Date of Manufacture, wherever available • Accessories supplied The details shall be submitted along with the supply. 11. Software & Operating System The laptop shall be supplied with genuine and properly licensed operating system/software as specified in the GeM Bid. All applicable licence keys, recovery media or digital licence information shall be provided wherever applicable. 12. Accessories All standard accessories supplied by the OEM along with the quoted model, including charger/adaptor, power cable and other standard accessories, shall be supplied along with the laptop without additional cost. 13. Data Security The supplied laptops shall be free from malware, viruses, spyware and other malicious

software at the time of delivery. No unauthorised software, remote-access application or hardware shall be installed in the laptops. 14. Replacement of Defective Items Any laptop found defective during inspection or within the applicable warranty period due to manufacturing defect shall be repaired/replaced by the supplier/OEM as per warranty terms without additional cost to the Buyer. 15. Documents to be Submitted The bidder shall submit, as applicable: 1. OEM Authorisation Certificate. 2. Technical compliance statement. 3. Product datasheet/brochure. 4. Country of Origin declaration. 5. Warranty details. 6. Make and exact model/part number. 7. Details of authorised service centre/support arrangement. 8. Any other document specifically asked for in the GeM Bid. 16. Technical Compliance & Rejection of Bid (a) The bidder shall ensure that the offered product fully conforms to all the technical specifications and requirements stipulated in the GeM Bid/BOQ. (b) In case the offered product does not fulfil any of the stipulated technical specifications, the bid shall be liable to be rejected as technically non-responsive. (c) Any deviation, shortfall or mismatch in the offered specifications shall be clearly indicated by the bidder. Silent deviation shall not be accepted. (d) The Buyer reserves the right to reject the bid at the technical evaluation stage if the offered product fails to meet the prescribed specifications or mandatory ATC requirements. Note: All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the GeM General Terms & Conditions (GTC), Bid/Contract conditions and applicable Government of India rules/orders. In case of any contradiction between these ATC and mandatory GeM/Government provisions, the applicable GeM/Government provisions shall prevail. .
